subject: Integration milestones & MAP: SDK + streaming + tool-calls
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir@beaconhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T16:05:00Z
Subject: Next steps: integration priorities & MAP sketch

Thanks again for the call earlier — good alignment from our side. Quick recap and asks so we can turn the MAP into an actionable build plan:

- Priority features: 1) SDK embed for our clinician portal (low-latency streaming for live notes), 2) Tool-calling to triage and surface structured outputs (ICD codes + disposition), 3) Embeddings for search ranking later phase.
- Must-haves: EU data residency (eu-west-1), SAML SSO, audit logs retention 1 year.
- Procurement note: our finance/procurement team needs an estimated integration timeline and a list of technical dependencies to start a purchase request.

Can you send a MAP draft with milestone owners + estimated dates so I can escalate internally? Also flag any blockers (e.g., engineering time, security questionnaires). I attached my quick notes from today.

Samir
Director of Platform Integrations
Beacon Health

Attachment: initial-call-notes.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T18:10:00Z
Subject: RE: Next steps: integration priorities & MAP sketch

Samir — thanks for the clear summary. Drafted a MAP attached (Beacon_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf) and an implementation checklist for the SDK path (sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx). High-level proposal below; please confirm or reprioritize.

Proposed MAP milestone highlights (target close: 2027-06-30):
- Milestone A — Auth & Access (SAML setup + service accounts) — Owner: Beacon IT (Priya Sethi) / Redwood: Tessa Morgan — Target: 2027-05-07
- Milestone B — SDK integration (client SDK + adapter for clinician portal) — Owner: Redwood eng (Dev Patel) / Beacon eng (Samir's team) — Target: 2027-05-28
- Milestone C — Streaming + KV cache validation (low-latency live notes) — Owner: Dev Patel — Target: 2027-06-11
- Milestone D — Tool-calling & structured outputs (schema + webhook wiring) — Owner: Jordan Blake / Beacon data team — Target: 2027-06-18
- Milestone E — Canary + performance validation in eu-west-1 — Owner: Marissa Cole — Target: 2027-06-24

Dependencies / blockers noted: SOC2 evidence (requested by Beacon legal), cert for eu-west-1, and procurement PO to be in place for final rollout.

Can you confirm Priya as the Beacon owner for Milestone A and if the target close 2027-06-30 works? I put the MAP draft in the attachment and will iterate once you confirm owners.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0124

Attachments: Beacon_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, sdk-integration-checklist.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T19:05:00Z
Subject: Re: RE: Next steps: integration priorities & MAP sketch

Looping in engineering notes on feasibility and a suggested technical split. Quick comments on the draft MAP: 

- Auth: SAML SSO is straightforward; Beacon should provide test IdP & metadata. Redwood will validate in staging (eu-west-1). Estimate: 3 engineering days across setup + verification.
- SDK integration: Recommend building a thin adapter in Beacon's portal to call Redwood hosted endpoint; basic SDK + wrapper should be ~8 dev days (Dev to lead). We should plan for one cross-company dev test week.
- Streaming: Real risk is latency at 99th pct for concurrent clinician sessions. We need to define expected concurrency in the MAP (Samir: what’s a realistic peak?). Suggest a streaming validation milestone that includes synthetic load tests and KV cache tuning.
- Tool calling & structured outputs: Need schema alignment session. Jordan to own schema draft, Beacon to own mapping.

Attachments: tech-constraints.md

Jordan
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Samir Khan <samir@beaconhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sethi <priya.s@beaconhealth.com>, procurement@beaconhealth.com
Date: 2027-04-20T09:20:00Z
Subject: RE: Next steps: integration priorities & MAP sketch

Thanks — this looks sensible. A few clarifications from Beacon: 

- Confirm Priya Sethi will lead Milestone A (yes).
- Expected concurrency for streaming initially: 12 concurrent sessions per region, ramping to 40 in Q4 — spell that out in the MAP.
- Procurement: we can get an initial PO in June if we have the MAP + rough SOW by 2027-05-05. Legal also asked for SOC2 + penetration test summary (we can accept Redwood’s SOC2 report).
- Region: eu-west-1 only for PII workloads; we can use hosted Redwood endpoints but must pin region.

We’re good to proceed — can you add procurement contact (procurement@beaconhealth.com) to follow-ups and include the PO milestone? Also need a canary plan (duration + rollback criteria) before june close.

Samir

On Mon, Apr 19, 2027 at 6:10 PM Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Samir — thanks for the clear summary. Drafted a MAP attached...

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@beaconhealth.com>, Priya Sethi <priya.s@beaconhealth.com>, procurement@beaconhealth.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:05:00Z
Subject: Finalize owners & dates — MAP v1 (action requested by 2027-04-23)

All — thanks for the quick replies. I updated the MAP and consolidated action items in the attached MAP_v1_for_beacon.pdf and also linked the live MAP in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-Beacon-MAP

Summary of agreed milestones and owners (please reply with OK / edits by 2027-04-23 so we can lock timelines):

1) Milestone A — Auth & Access (SAML + service accounts)
   - Owner (Beacon): Priya Sethi (priya.s@beaconhealth.com)
   - Owner (Redwood): Tessa Morgan
   - Target: 2027-05-07
   - Dependencies: test IdP metadata, SOC2 evidence

2) Milestone B — SDK integration (client SDK + wrapper)
   - Owner (Beacon): Samir Khan
   - Owner (Redwood): Dev Patel (dev@redwood.com)
   - Target: 2027-05-28
   - Dependencies: SDK checklist, cross-company dev week

3) Milestone C — Streaming validation (low-latency, 12 -> 40 concurrency)
   - Owner (Redwood): Dev Patel
   - Target: 2027-06-11
   - Dependencies: synthetic load tests, KV cache tuning

4) Milestone D — Tool-calling & structured outputs (schema + webhooks)
   - Owner (Redwood): Jordan Blake
   - Owner (Beacon): Beacon data team
   - Target: 2027-06-18
   - Dependencies: schema alignment session, webhook security review

5) Milestone E — Canary + performance validation (eu-west-1)
   - Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole
   - Target: 2027-06-24
   - Dependencies: PO in place, canary duration & rollback plan

Procurement milestone: PO target 2027-06-01 (procurement@beaconhealth.com to confirm).

Next steps:
- Beacon: confirm Priya as Milestone A owner and procurement PO timeline.
- Redwood: Dev to post a short SDK implementation plan (1 pager) in Drive and Jordan to circulate schema draft by 2027-04-22.
- Tessa: I'll update the MAP after your confirmations and send a final SOW placeholder for procurement.

Please reply with short confirmations so we can lock dates — aiming to finalize by 2027-04-23 so procurement can begin internal approvals.

Best —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v1_for_beacon.pdf
